rows.title: Ongoing support
rows.summary: Websites change. So do businesses. We're here for you even after handover.

about.title: About us and Pictus
about.text: Peter: a programmer to the core — backend is his true love: databases, reservation systems, servers, apps, logic.. but the colouring and styling, that's Barbora's world: design, aesthetics, the feeling and the vibe. Everything has to be in its place — only then is she happy. Otherwise, these two can talk for hours about the eternity of the soul, psyché and zoé, and delight in the little everyday things. And Pictus is proof you don't need to code or design to be on the team — you just need good vibes and coffee within reach. Our mascot, morale support and the calmest member of the company.

rows.title: Listen
rows.summary: We start with a conversation to find out what you really need, who it's for, and how the whole thing should feel.

rows.title: Shape
rows.summary: We turn what we heard into structure and direction. Clear logic before we touch anything visual.

rows.title: Build
rows.summary: Once we agree on the shape, we move into design and development. Step by step, with milestones you'll always know about.

rows.title: Hand over
rows.summary: We hand over a working result you can use, with an explanation of how, and the reassurance that we're here if anything comes up.

Legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains which personal data we process on pictusweb.sk, in the FleetSync service and when working with clients, why we do it, on what legal basis, who we share data with, how long we keep it and what rights you have. It is based on Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Slovak Act No. 18/2018 Coll. on personal data protection. The Slovak version is authoritative.
Legal.privacyControllerText:
Pictusweb s.r.o., Nábrežná 4895/42, 940 02 Nové Zámky, Slovak Republic
Company ID: 54 631 068, Tax ID: 2121741424
Registered in the Commercial Register of the District Court Nitra, section: Sro, file no. 57457/N
Email: info@pictusweb.sk, phone: +421 948 024 638
Contact person for data protection: Peter Varga, peter.varga@pictusweb.sk
We have not appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) as GDPR does not require it for us.
Legal.privacyContactFormText:
Data: name, email, phone (if provided), message text; technical submission data (IP address, browser, language, referrer, time spent filling in the form).
Purpose: to answer your enquiry, prepare a quote and protect the form against spam.
Legal basis: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); for general questions and spam protection our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We do not need your consent to process the form.
Retention: 2 years from the last communication. If the enquiry leads to a contract, we process the data as described in section 3.
Legal.privacyClientsTitle: 3. Clients – web development, redesign, support and AI services
Legal.privacyClientsText:
Data: name of the contact person, email, phone, billing details (company name, address, company ID, tax ID), project communication and materials you provide.
Purpose: concluding and performing the contract, invoicing, handling complaints.
Legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); bookkeeping as a legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR); for contact persons of business clients our legitimate interest in communicating with the client (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Retention: for the duration of the contract and 4 years after it ends (limitation period); accounting documents 10 years under Act No. 431/2002 Coll. on accounting.
Where we build or maintain a website for you and process personal data of your customers in doing so, we act as your processor and a separate data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR applies.
Legal.privacyFleetSyncText:
Data: name, email and phone of the contact person and other users, login credentials (passwords are stored only in hashed form), organisation details (name, company ID, tax ID, address), vehicle data (registration number, deadlines for technical inspection, emissions check, insurance, service etc., costs and mileage), history of sent notifications, billing details.
Purpose: creating and managing the account, verifying email and phone, sending notifications by email and SMS, customer support, invoicing.
Legal basis: performance of a contract under the FleetSync Terms (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); for users added by an organisation the legitimate interest of the organisation and of ours in operating the service (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); bookkeeping as a legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).
Retention: for the duration of the contract and 30 days after it ends (for data export), then deleted. Accounting documents 10 years.
If you record employees' private vehicles in FleetSync, your organisation is the controller responsible for that processing and we act as its processor.
Legal.privacyNewsletterTitle: 5. FleetSync – product news and release notes (newsletter)
Legal.privacyNewsletterText:
We send FleetSync customers emails about the service – new features, changes and usage tips.
Data: organisation email address, organisation name.
Legal basis: sending information about our own similar services to existing customers under Section 116(15) of Slovak Act No. 452/2021 Coll. on electronic communications and our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We inform you about this at registration.
Unsubscribe: at any time with one click on the "unsubscribe" link in every email or by writing to info@pictusweb.sk. Unsubscribing does not affect vehicle notifications, which are part of the service.
Retention: while you are our customer or until you unsubscribe; after unsubscribing we keep only the opt-out record so we do not email you again.
Legal.privacyClientZoneText:
You can sign in to the client zone with email and password or with a Google or GitHub account. When you sign in with Google or GitHub, the provider shares your name, email and profile picture with us; these companies are independent controllers of your account with them.
Legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Retention: while the account exists.
Legal.privacyPaymentsText:
Card payments are processed by Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd. (Ireland). You enter your card details directly into the Stripe payment gateway – we never see or store them. Stripe only tells us the payment result and subscription status. For bank transfers we process payment details from our account statement at Fio banka, a.s.
Legal basis: performance of a contract and accounting obligations (Art. 6(1)(b) and (c) GDPR).

- NEXT_LOCALE – remembers the selected website language

Analytics (only with your consent):
- Umami – our own analytics tool running on our server (analytics.pictusweb.com). It does not use cookies, does not store your IP address and does not build visitor profiles; we only see aggregate statistics (visits, pages viewed, country, device type). It starts only after you click "Accept".

We do not use marketing or advertising cookies, tracking pixels (e.g. Meta Pixel), Google Analytics, reCAPTCHA or social media plugins. Fonts are served from our own server, not from Google.

Changing your choice: click "Cookie settings" in the website footer – the bar appears again and you can withdraw consent as easily as you gave it.

Visit counter: on your first choice in the cookie bar (accept or decline) we increase the total visit count by one. No data about you is stored.

To protect the website and services against abuse (spam, repeated failed sign-ins, attacks) we process IP address, browser details and request time. Our hosting providers keep technical server logs.
Legal basis: our legitimate interest in security (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
When a FleetSync notification is confirmed, we record the IP address and browser as proof of confirmation.
Retention: records of blocked spam 90 days; notification confirmation records 12 months; records of suspicious IP addresses 90 days after last activity, or for the duration of a permanent block; server logs according to the hosting provider's settings, usually no more than a few weeks.
Legal.privacyRecipientsText:
We do not sell your data. We share it only with processors who provide technical operations for us, and only to the extent necessary:
- Hostinger International Ltd. (Cyprus) – web hosting
- Contabo GmbH (Germany) – servers
- Vercel Inc. (USA) – hosting and website delivery
- Cloudflare, Inc. (USA) – DNS, attack protection and website delivery; processes the IP address and technical data of every request to our domains
- Titan Mail (titan.email) – business mailbox and sending emails
- COM-TRADE s.r.o., smstools.sk service (Slovakia) – sending FleetSync SMS notifications
- Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd. (Ireland) – card payments and subscription management
- OpenAI (OpenAI Ireland Ltd., US parent company), ElevenLabs (USA) – AI services under section 8

As independent controllers, data may be received by: Google and GitHub (if you sign in with them), Fio banka, a.s. (bank transfers) and public authorities where required by law.

Some processors (Vercel, Cloudflare, Titan Mail, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Stripe) are based in the USA or have a US parent company, so data may be transferred to the USA. Transfers take place only with appropriate safeguards under Chapter V GDPR – based on certification under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework where the recipient holds it, or on standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission (Art. 46 GDPR). We will provide a copy of the safeguards on request.
Legal.privacyRetentionText:

- Client contracts and communication: duration of the contract + 4 years
- Accounting documents: 10 years
- FleetSync account: duration of the contract + 30 days
- FleetSync newsletter: while you are a customer or until you unsubscribe

- Spam records: 90 days

After the retention period we delete or anonymise the data.
Legal.privacyRightsText:
You have the right to:
- access your data and get a copy (Art. 15 GDPR),
- rectification of inaccurate data (Art. 16),
- erasure (Art. 17) where we no longer need the data or process it unlawfully,
- restriction of processing (Art. 18),
- portability of data you provided under a contract or consent (Art. 20),
- object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21) – to the newsletter at any time without giving a reason,
- withdraw consent at any time; this does not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.
Send requests to info@pictusweb.sk. We will respond without undue delay and within 1 month at the latest; in complex cases we may extend this by 2 further months and will let you know.
If you believe we process your data unlawfully, you can lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic, Hraničná 12, 820 07 Bratislava 27, www.dataprotection.gov.sk.
Legal.privacySecurityText: We protect data with appropriate technical and organisational measures: encrypted connection (HTTPS), passwords stored only in hashed form, access limited to authorised persons, email and phone verification at registration and abuse protection on forms. If a personal data breach occurs that may pose a risk to your rights, we will notify the Office for Personal Data Protection within 72 hours and, where the risk is high, inform you without undue delay.
Legal.privacyAutomatedText: We do not carry out automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal effects concerning you or similarly significantly affects you.
Legal.privacyChangesText: We update this policy regularly, especially when tools, processors or purposes change. The current version is always on this page; we inform customers of material changes by email. This version is effective from 08.10.2026.
